title: NetConfig-Semantic (repaired): a preregistered, reproducible benchmark for verifier-based semantic correctness of LLM-generated network configurations
research_question: Can a reproducible benchmark using deterministic template baselines and an open-source verifier reliably detect and quantify semantic errors (reachability, ACL equivalence, BGP policy preservation) in LLM-generated device configurations across vendor syntaxes and topology classes?
confirmatory_hypotheses: H1 (confirmatory): The single-pass LLM generation pipeline has a lower task-level verifier pass rate than a deterministic template baseline; estimand = paired success-rate difference (LLM_success_rate minus baseline_success_rate) across N=120 tasks, tested with a paired_binary_analysis_v1 executor.

H2 (confirmatory): The rank-order stability of task-level verifier pass/fail across bootstrap resamples is low for token/fluency metrics but reliably captured by verifier-based binary success, as measured by Kendall tau on aggregated task success rates (exploratory-supported, pre-specified analysis).
exploratory_questions: EQ1: How sensitive are measured LLM semantic-error rates to sampling multiple generation seeds per task (seed sensitivity)?
EQ2: What common semantic error classes (parse/ACL/BGP/misapplied-route) appear, and how do they correlate with topology class and vendor syntax?
benchmark_scope: 120 intent→config tasks programmatically generated across 3 topology classes (edge, datacenter, multi‑AS)
3 vendor syntax families: vendor-A CLI, vendor-B CLI, vendor-neutral device model (all syntaxes defined by transformation rules published in repo)
Public release of task JSON, transformation code, verifier input, and all outputs; no private data
primary_estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline (paired_binary_analysis_v1): per-task binary success (verifier-pass) for LLM single-pass generation minus deterministic template baseline, averaged over N=120 paired tasks
secondary_estimands: seed_sensitivity_failure_rate: change in per-task pass probability across additional generation seeds (exploratory)
rank_stability_kendall_tau: Kendall tau of task success-rate rankings across 1000 bootstrap resamples (exploratory)
sampling_plan: Confirmatory sample: N=120 tasks (equal allocation across 3 topology classes => 40 tasks per topology). Per-task confirmatory generation: 1 canonical seed (seed_0) used for the paired analysis. Exploratory sampling: 4 additional independent seeds per task (seed_1..seed_4) for seed-sensitivity analysis (exploratory only). Tasks are programmatically synthesized from an intent template bank; inclusion rule: task passes transformation unit tests (gold-config parses and baseline verifies). Exclusion rule: tasks failing gold-config generation unit tests are excluded before runs and replaced to preserve N=120. Total confirmatory LLM calls = 120. Planned maximum_model_calls for execution contract = 240 (one initial generation per condition per task, at most one repair episode).
power_and_precision_plan: Primary estimand: detect an absolute paired difference of 0.15 in verifier pass probability at two-sided alpha=0.05 with target power >=0.80. N=120 paired tasks (40 per topology) chosen per simulation approximations under baseline pass≈0.9 and LLM≈0.75 assumptions. Primary CI via 10,000 bootstrap resamples. Sensitivity power recomputed excluding suspected-contamination items and under worst-case contamination.
exclusion_rules: Exclude and replace any task whose gold-template fails unit tests (parsing or verifier pass) prior to model calls to preserve N=120.
Primary analysis uses 'complete_pair_primary': drop pairs only if both baseline and LLM calls fail infrastructure-wise.
Sensitivity analysis treats failed model calls as verifier-failures (binary=0).
missingness_plan: Record all model-call and verifier runtime failures. Primary treatment: pairs with infrastructure call failures are excluded only if the baseline also failed the equivalent infrastructure step ('complete_pair_primary'). Sensitivity alternative 'complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity' treats failed model calls as verifier failures (binary=0). If >10% of confirmatory pairs are excluded due to infrastructure issues, halt and retry according to preregistered retry policy (up to 2 automatic retries per failed call). All exclusions, retries, and timestamps are logged and published.
analysis_plan: Primary confirmatory analysis executed by 'paired_binary_analysis_v1'. For each task i, baseline_i = deterministic-template verifier pass (binary), llm_i = verifier pass for LLM seed_0 (binary). Paired estimator = mean(llm_i - baseline_i) over i=1..120. Primary inference: bootstrap 95% CI on paired difference (10,000 resamples) and two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test on paired differences. Pre-specified failed_call_treatment: 'complete_pair_primary' (primary) and sensitivity 'complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity'. Exploratory analyses: seed sensitivity across seeds_1..4, compute Cohen's d on any continuous verifier severity score if derived, and compute Kendall tau rank stability via 1000 bootstrap resamples. All analysis code, seeds, and outputs archived in public repo.
multiplicity_plan: Single primary confirmatory test (H1) with alpha=0.05. Exploratory analyses (seed sensitivity, error taxonomy, rank stability) labeled exploratory and reported without confirmatory multiplicity corrections. Exploratory p-values are for hypothesis generation only.
contamination_plan: Detection: exact-match detection (flag 'verbatim_match_suspected_contamination'); normalized Levenshtein and 5-gram overlap thresholds to flag 'high_overlap' or 'suspected_contamination'; self-bleu N-gram overlap with repo artifacts. Flagging rules: 'suspected_contamination' if exact match OR normalized 5-gram overlap >= 0.95; 'high_overlap' if normalized Levenshtein >= 0.9 and not exact match. Analysis treatment: primary estimand reports inclusive results (all tasks). Secondary sensitivity: report estimand excluding suspected-contamination items and with suspected-contamination items forced to failure (worst-case). Residual uncertainty: training-data exposure cannot be fully proven; string-similarity is an imperfect proxy.
stopping_rule: If >10% of confirmatory pairs are excluded due to infrastructure failures after up to 2 automatic retries per failed call, abort the confirmatory run and report as incomplete; otherwise proceed to analysis. Any run-level aborts, retries, and reasons are logged and published.
planned_outputs: IEEE-formatted short paper PDF (<=5 pages) including Disclosure Statement
Public Git repository with: task JSON, transformation code, parser, verifier input schemas, unit tests, all LLM outputs, baseline outputs, raw verifier logs, analysis code, seeds, and hashes
Docker image reference and pinned verifier (Batfish) version, CI-style mapping tests
Statistical results file (bootstrap replicates, test statistics)
Evidence-to-claim table, nearest-work comparison matrix, NotebookLM presentation brief
